items.title: Why Lufthansa's New Economy Basic Punishes Even Its Elite Flyers
items.summary: The latest fare overhaul from Lufthansa represents more than just a tweak to pricing: it signals a shift in how one of Europe’s flagship carriers defines the baseline economy experience. In late spring 2026, the airline introduced an 'Economy Basic' fare across its short- and medium-haul European network that removes a feature long considered standard: the ability to bring a carry-on bag for the overhead locker.
